text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City Policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is recommending that stopping be prohibited at all times on both sides of Grosvenor Street, between Yonge Street and a point 67 metres west, in order to provide clear access for emergency service vehicles to/from the fire hall at 12 Grosvenor Street.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the north side of Grosvenor Street, between a point 49 metres west of Yonge Street and a point 18 metres further west. 2. Rescinded the existing standing prohibition in effect at all times on the south side of Grosvenor Street, between a point 49 metres west of Yonge Street and a point 18 metres further west. 3. Prohibited stopping at all times on both sides of Grosvenor Street, between a point 49 metres west of Yonge Street and a point 18 metres further west. 4. Authorized the existing stopping prohibition in effect at all times on both sides of Grosvenor Street, between Yonge Street and a point 49 metres west, to remain after the completion of the construction project at 480-494 Yonge Street (Item TE32.52 at the May 2, 2018 Toronto and East York Community Council…
